themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent crashes, freezes, and glitches within the app, rendering it unusable. Common symptoms include slow performance, failed logins, and data fetching errors.
themes.business_impact: High risk of customer dissatisfaction, potential churn, and reputational damage if issues persist and are not addressed promptly.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The underlying cause might be related to poor code quality, inadequate testing, or insufficient resources allocated to maintenance and support.
themes.action_plan:
• Improve app stability
• Conduct thorough bug testing and analysis
• Enhance maintenance and support processes
• Communicate status updates and fixes to customers.

themes.description: The app's order execution system is plagued with issues such as automatic sale of shares at low prices, manipulation of profit and loss, and inconsistent execution of buy and sell orders. Users also express discontent with the system's ability to manipulate prices and automatically place and sell orders for brokerage gains.
themes.business_impact: Potential losses for users, damage to brand reputation, and erosion of customer trust.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's algorithms and system design may be flawed, leading to inconsistent order execution and manipulation of user trades.
themes.action_plan: • Review and refactor the order execution system to ensure transparency and consistency in order execution. Implement user controls to prevent automatic sale of shares and other manipulative behaviors. Provide clear and transparent explanations of system trades to users.
